prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent equipment sprite atlas for Emberveil, a dark post-apocalyptic pixel RPG. Exactly SIX isolated objects in a regular 3 columns x 2 rows grid, landscape canvas. Top row left to right: a long worn bayonet knife (dark iron blade and leather wrapped short hilt, blade points RIGHT); a utilitarian old laser rifle (dark grey worn steel, small muted red power emitter, muzzle RIGHT, stock LEFT); an olive round fragmentation grenade with pin and lever, upright. Bottom row left to right: a sleek angular plasma rifle (dark blue-grey steel, restrained amber power chamber, muzzle RIGHT, stock LEFT); an energy blade (short dark hilt LEFT and long narrow pale amber energized solid blade RIGHT); a compact disruptor pistol (dark grey body, short wide ring-shaped muted teal emitter at RIGHT, grip left beneath body). Consistent crisp hand-dithered pixel-art clusters, 1-pixel dark outline, dusty olive, dark steel, brown and limited amber/teal highlights. Readable when scaled to 12-70 pixels wide. Full side-on orthographic objects, NO hands or characters. All long weapons perfectly horizontal, each entirely within its own cell. Generous fully transparent gutters and outer margins, minimum 20% padding on all sides per cell; no overlap between rows. No loose projectiles, no large glow haze, no shadows, no floor, no text, no grid, no labels, no background or checkerboard. Real transparent RGBA background.
